units.title: Read-only readiness probing with exact response checks
scope: Validate centrally approved credential-free HTTPS readiness targets before any request.
Perform bounded GET-only probes with redirects disabled, strict timeouts, exact expected 2xx status, JSON object requirements and scalar readiness predicates.
Fail closed without logging response bodies; repeated same-runner samples remain distinct from the independent multi-region quorum planned by DDM-014.
units.acceptanceCriteria: Complete safe read-only readiness probing with exact response checks, automated failure-boundary tests, operational documentation, exact-head CI validation and recorded acceptance evidence.

units.title: Hardened failover policy planner, default non-executing
scope: Return immutable, explicitly non-executing failover decisions from validated policy and observation evidence.

Require active auto-verified policy, zero-dollar constraints, independent failure quorum, routing authority, central target approval, one unhealthy primary and a healthy same-release standby on another provider.
Require writer fencing and an exclusive lease for stateful proposals; select eligible candidates deterministically without mutating input.
units.acceptanceCriteria: Complete fail-closed non-executing failover policy planning, safety-gate and authorization-negative tests, operational documentation, exact-head CI validation and recorded acceptance evidence.

units.title: Central read-only GitHub Actions scanning and reusable CI
scope: Run bounded read-only scans against exact default-branch deployment contracts through a fixed GitHub API origin.
Keep missing, unavailable, invalid, inventory-only, awaiting-approval, ready and degraded states distinct without exposing response bodies or credentials.
Probe only centrally approved targets and preserve zero authority for deployment, spending, routing, writer fencing or automatic failover.
Provide a least-privilege reusable contract-validation workflow and documented operational limitations and rollback.
units.acceptanceCriteria: Complete strict manifest-response decoding, authorization-negative and failure-boundary tests, least-privilege central and reusable workflows, deterministic status reporting, operational documentation, exact-head CI validation and recorded acceptance evidence.

units.title: Integrate all eligible 58 repositories, no deployment assumed
scope: Ensure every eligible repository has a repository-bound public-safe deployment contract and reusable central validation workflow.
Keep unverified or unclassified projects inventory-only with a hard zero-dollar budget, no endpoint and disabled failover.
Reconcile existing integration pull requests before creating missing enrollment work and do not alter explicitly excluded repositories.
units.acceptanceCriteria: All in-scope repositories are enrolled on their default branches through validated inventory-only contracts and least-privilege reusable CI; all contributing pull requests pass required exact-head and merged-branch checks; exclusions remain untouched; canonical evidence and rollback are documented without claiming a deployment.
